snippet.title: Halloween: The Game Single-Player Campaign Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/1148090

A new gameplay trailer for Halloween: The Game focused on the single-player aspect of the game, where you play through Michael Myers' origin story as he evolves into the masked, knife-wielding killer we know him as today. It's coming on September 8, later this year.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
